categories.main_business_segments: NARI Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: Smart Grid, Digital-Energy Integration, Energy Low-Carbon, and Industrial Internet. The company provides products and integrated solutions including power grid safety and stability analysis, power dispatch automation, power market, new energy grid integration control, next-generation centralized control, relay protection, substation intelligent inspection, DC transmission systems, flexible AC transmission systems, and energy storage systems. It also offers industrial process control, enterprise energy management, urban rail transit integrated monitoring systems, and electrical automation products for various industries such as energy, municipal utilities, environmental protection, water conservancy, rail transit, and mining.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including computer technology, electronic technology, signal processing, communication technology, power electronics, and digital twin platforms. Key technologies include relay protection, flexible AC/DC transmission, source-grid-load-storage coordinated control, virtual power plants, and IGBT modules. It employs order-based production with engineering design, procurement of electronic and electrical components, proprietary core technologies, software and hardware development, and system integration. The company also emphasizes research and development with a focus on artificial intelligence, digital twin, blockchain, edge computing, and cybersecurity.
categories.primary_customers_markets: NARI serves primarily the energy and power sector, including national and regional power grids, power generation enterprises (hydropower, thermal, wind, solar, nuclear), municipal utilities, environmental protection, water conservancy, rail transit, and industrial mining sectors. Major customers include State Grid Corporation and its subsidiaries, China Energy Engineering Group, China Huaneng Group, and other large state-owned enterprises. The company also actively expands international markets, notably in Saudi Arabia, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with headquarters and major facilities in Nanjing and subsidiaries nationwide. It has international subsidiaries and operations in countries including Indonesia, Brazil, Malaysia, Nigeria, the UK, India, Ecuador, and Chile. Overseas business is growing rapidly, with significant projects in the Middle East, South America, and Southeast Asia. The company’s products and services cover over 100 countries and regions globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: NARI operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy and industrial supply chain. It develops and manufactures core electrical and electronic equipment, software, and integrated solutions for power generation, transmission, distribution, and consumption. The company also provides engineering services, system integration, and operation and maintenance services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the energy internet and industrial automation ecosystems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven development, emphasizing original innovation and core technology breakthroughs in smart grids, digital-energy integration, energy low-carbon technologies, and industrial internet. R&D priorities include source-grid-load-storage coordination, virtual power plants, AI integration, digital twin platforms, power electronics, and new energy system control technologies. It actively participates in national key projects, standards formulation, and international technology leadership. The company plans to deepen AI, digital twin, intelligent sensing, and new materials research to support new energy systems and industrial digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: NARI generates revenue primarily through product sales of electrical and electronic equipment, software, and integrated systems. It also earns income from engineering contracting, system integration services, operation and maintenance services, and technology licensing. The company operates on an order-based production model, securing contracts mainly through bidding processes. Additionally, it derives investment income from financial assets and government subsidies related to technology and innovation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: NARI is a leading domestic player and market leader in China's energy and power automation sector, recognized as a benchmark enterprise by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission. It holds a dominant position in smart grid technologies, relay protection, flexible AC/DC transmission, and energy low-carbon solutions. The company competes with other major Chinese power equipment manufacturers and system integrators but differentiates itself through its comprehensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and integration of digital technologies. It is also expanding its international footprint to compete globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, NARI achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 57.42 billion, representing an 11.15% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.61 billion, a 6.06% increase. The company’s total assets reached RMB 92.7 billion, with net assets of RMB 49.22 billion. It maintains a stable growth trajectory with continuous investment in R&D (over RMB 4 billion annually) and expanding international business. The company’s cash flow from operations remains robust, though investment activities show significant outflows due to capital expenditures and financial product investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: NARI emphasizes its unique value proposition as a world-class high-tech leader in the energy internet sector, offering integrated smart grid and energy digitalization solutions with strong innovation capabilities. Its products and solutions are characterized by high reliability, advanced technology, and comprehensive coverage across the entire energy lifecycle from generation to consumption. The company’s competitive differentiation lies in its deep integration of digital technologies (AI, digital twin, blockchain), strong R&D foundation, extensive industry experience, and ability to provide customized, end-to-end solutions that support national strategic goals such as carbon neutrality and new energy system construction.
